_comment: DE/EN/TR texts of Glassbed (Windows and Android). Edit here; tools/export_shared.py copies them into the apps.

Show icon in the notification area.en: Show icon in the notification area

With the icon, closing the window keeps.en: With the icon, closing the window keeps Glassbed running in the notification area; it can scan from there and warns when toner runs low.
With the icon, closing the window keeps.de: Mit dem Symbol läuft Glassbed beim Schließen des Fensters im Infobereich weiter; von dort kann gescannt werden, und es warnt, wenn der Toner zur Neige geht.
With the icon, closing the window keeps.tr: Simge açıkken pencereyi kapatmak Glassbed'i bildirim alanında çalışır durumda tutar; oradan tarama yapılabilir ve toner azaldığında uyarır.

This system has no notification area..en: This system has no notification area.

Glassbed keeps running in the notificati.en: Glassbed keeps running in the notification area.
Glassbed keeps running in the notificati.tr: Glassbed bildirim alanında çalışmaya devam ediyor.

Glassbed {version} is downloading in you.en: Glassbed {version} is downloading in your browser

Start the setup after the download – you.en: Start the setup after the download – your settings are kept.
Start the setup after the download – you.de: Nach dem Download das Setup starten – deine Einstellungen bleiben erhalten.
Start the setup after the download – you.tr: İndirme bittikten sonra kurulumu başlatın – ayarlarınız korunur.

Glassbed can look for a new version on G.en: Glassbed can look for a new version on GitHub – at most once a day. GitHub sees your IP address when it does. Nothing is installed automatically; you decide each time. You can change this later in the settings.
Glassbed can look for a new version on G.de: Glassbed kann auf GitHub nach einer neuen Version suchen – höchstens einmal am Tag. GitHub sieht dabei deine IP-Adresse. Es wird nichts automatisch installiert; du entscheidest jedes Mal selbst. Du kannst das später in den Einstellungen ändern.
Glassbed can look for a new version on G.tr: Glassbed, GitHub'da yeni bir sürüm olup olmadığına bakabilir – en fazla günde bir kez. Bu sırada GitHub IP adresinizi görür. Hiçbir şey otomatik olarak yüklenmez; her seferinde siz karar verirsiniz. Bunu daha sonra ayarlardan değiştirebilirsiniz.

At most once a day Glassbed asks GitHub.en: At most once a day Glassbed asks GitHub whether a new version exists. GitHub sees your IP address. Nothing is installed automatically.
At most once a day Glassbed asks GitHub.de: Höchstens einmal am Tag fragt Glassbed bei GitHub, ob es eine neue Version gibt. GitHub sieht deine IP-Adresse. Es wird nichts automatisch installiert.
At most once a day Glassbed asks GitHub.tr: Glassbed en fazla günde bir kez GitHub'a yeni bir sürüm olup olmadığını sorar. GitHub IP adresinizi görür. Hiçbir şey otomatik olarak yüklenmez.

Glassbed is an open-source project by {c.en: Glassbed is an open-source project by {company}.
Glassbed is an open-source project by {c.tr: Glassbed, {company} tarafından geliştirilen açık kaynaklı bir projedir.

IT service · Göttingen & nationwide.tr: BT hizmeti · Göttingen ve tüm Almanya

{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved.en: {n} scanned page(s) have not been saved yet. If you close Glassbed now, they are lost.
{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved.de: {n} gescannte Seite(n) sind noch nicht gespeichert. Wenn du Glassbed jetzt schließt, gehen sie verloren.
{n} scanned page(s) have not been saved.tr: {n} taranmış sayfa henüz kaydedilmedi. Glassbed'yi şimdi kapatırsanız kaybolur.

A scan is still running. If you close Gl.en: A scan is still running. If you close Glassbed now, it is cancelled and the pages are lost.
A scan is still running. If you close Gl.de: Ein Scan läuft noch. Wenn du Glassbed jetzt schließt, wird er abgebrochen und die Seiten gehen verloren.
A scan is still running. If you close Gl.tr: Bir tarama devam ediyor. Glassbed'yi şimdi kapatırsanız iptal edilir ve sayfalar kaybolur.

Blur suits faces and photos. For numbers.en: Blur suits faces and photos. For numbers like an IBAN, black is safer.
Blur suits faces and photos. For numbers.de: Unscharf passt für Gesichter und Fotos. Für Zahlen wie eine IBAN ist Schwarz sicherer.
Blur suits faces and photos. For numbers.tr: Bulanık, yüzler ve fotoğraflar için uygundur. IBAN gibi numaralar için siyah daha güvenlidir.

Mouse wheel: zoom · Space or right mouse.en: Mouse wheel: zoom · Space or right mouse button + drag: move
Mouse wheel: zoom · Space or right mouse.de: Mausrad: zoomen · Leertaste oder rechte Maustaste + ziehen: verschieben
Mouse wheel: zoom · Space or right mouse.tr: Fare tekerleği: yakınlaştır · Boşluk veya sağ fare tuşu + sürükle: kaydır

Drag a box over what should disappear. C.en: Drag a box over what should disappear. Click a box to select it, Del removes it. It is burned into the saved file and cannot be undone there.
Drag a box over what should disappear. C.de: Rechteck über das ziehen, was verschwinden soll. Rechteck anklicken und ziehen zum Verschieben, an den Griffpunkten zum Vergrößern, Pfeiltasten zum Feinjustieren, Entf zum Löschen. Im gespeicherten Dokument ist die Schwärzung fest eingebrannt.
Drag a box over what should disappear. C.tr: Gizlenecek alanın üzerine bir kutu çizin. Taşımak için kutuyu sürükleyin, boyutlandırmak için tutamaçları kullanın, ince ayar için ok tuşları, silmek için Del. Kaydedilen dosyada karartma kalıcıdır.

Find the document on the scanner glass.en: Find the document on the scanner glass
Find the document on the scanner glass.de: Dokument auf dem Scannerglas automatisch finden

Drag the frame or its handles. Double-cl.en: Drag the frame or its handles. Double-click: whole page.
Drag the frame or its handles. Double-cl.de: Rahmen oder Griffpunkte ziehen. Doppelklick: ganze Seite.
Drag the frame or its handles. Double-cl.tr: Çerçeveyi veya tutamaçları sürükleyin. Çift tıklama: tüm sayfa.

Scans are saved here unless you pick ano.en: Scans are saved here unless you pick another folder in the scan tab.
Scans are saved here unless you pick ano.de: Scans werden hier gespeichert, außer du wählst im Scan-Tab einen anderen Ordner.
Scans are saved here unless you pick ano.tr: Tarama sekmesinde başka bir klasör seçmezseniz taramalar buraya kaydedilir.

No devices found. Enter the IP address m.en: No devices found. Enter the IP address manually.
No devices found. Enter the IP address m.de: Keine Geräte gefunden. Bitte IP-Adresse eingeben.
No devices found. Enter the IP address m.tr: Cihaz bulunamadı. IP adresini elle girin.

Open the printer's built-in web page.en: Open the printer's built-in web page

IP address or host name.tr: IP adresi veya ana bilgisayar adı

This device cannot scan – printing only..en: This device cannot scan – printing only.
This device cannot scan – printing only..de: Dieses Gerät kann nicht scannen – nur Drucken.
This device cannot scan – printing only..tr: Bu cihaz tarama yapamaz – yalnızca yazdırma.

Next scan is added to the current pages..en: Next scan is added to the current pages.
Next scan is added to the current pages..de: Neue Scans werden an die vorhandenen Seiten angehängt.

Place a document on the glass or in the.en:
Place a document on the glass or in the feeder
and click “Scan”.
Place a document on the glass or in the.de:
Lege ein Dokument auf das Glas oder in den Einzug
und klicke auf „Scannen“.
Place a document on the glass or in the.tr:
Belgeyi cama veya besleyiciye yerleştirin
ve “Tara”ya tıklayın.

The document feeder is empty. Insert pag.en: The document feeder is empty. Insert pages or use the glass.
The document feeder is empty. Insert pag.de: Der Vorlageneinzug ist leer. Lege Seiten ein oder nutze das Glas.
The document feeder is empty. Insert pag.tr: Belge besleyici boş. Sayfa yerleştirin veya camı kullanın.

The scanner is busy. Try again in a mome.en: The scanner is busy. Try again in a moment.
The scanner is busy. Try again in a mome.de: Der Scanner ist beschäftigt. Versuch es gleich nochmal.

Drop PDFs or images here\nor click “Add.en:
Drop PDFs or images here
or click “Add files…”.
Drop PDFs or images here\nor click “Add.de:
PDFs oder Bilder hierher ziehen
oder „Dateien hinzufügen…“ klicken.
Drop PDFs or images here\nor click “Add.tr:
PDF veya resimleri buraya sürükleyin
ya da “Dosya ekle…”ye tıklayın.

Print both sides by reinserting the stac.en: Print both sides by reinserting the stack
Print both sides by reinserting the stac.de: Beidseitig drucken durch Wiedereinlegen des Stapels
Print both sides by reinserting the stac.tr: Kâğıt destesini yeniden yerleştirerek iki yüze yazdır

The front sides are printing.\n\nWhen th.en:
The front sides are printing.

When they are done, take the stack from the output tray and put it back into the paper tray so the blank sides get printed (usually: do not flip it, just move it).

Tip: try it once with 4 pages.

Continue with the back sides?
The front sides are printing.\n\nWhen th.de:
Die Vorderseiten werden gedruckt.

Wenn sie fertig sind, nimm den Stapel aus dem Ausgabefach und lege ihn wieder ins Papierfach, sodass die leeren Seiten bedruckt werden (meist: nicht umdrehen, einfach umlegen).

Tipp: Probier es einmal mit 4 Seiten aus.

Mit den Rückseiten fortfahren?
The front sides are printing.\n\nWhen th.tr:
Ön yüzler yazdırılıyor.

Bittiğinde desteyi çıkış tepsisinden alın ve boş yüzler yazdırılacak şekilde kâğıt tepsisine geri koyun (genellikle: çevirmeden, olduğu gibi taşıyın).

İpucu: Bir kez 4 sayfayla deneyin.

Arka yüzlerle devam edilsin mi?

Send this report to the developer if the.en: Send this report to the developer if the device does not work with Glassbed. It contains the device's address, model and supported protocols – nothing else.
Send this report to the developer if the.de: Schick diesen Bericht an den Entwickler, wenn das Gerät nicht mit Glassbed funktioniert. Er enthält Adresse, Modell und unterstützte Protokolle des Geräts – sonst nichts.
Send this report to the developer if the.tr: Cihaz Glassbed ile çalışmıyorsa bu raporu geliştiriciye gönderin. Yalnızca cihazın adresini, modelini ve desteklenen protokolleri içerir.

Only devices on the local network can be.en: Only devices on the local network can be used ({host}).
Only devices on the local network can be.de: Es können nur Geräte im lokalen Netzwerk verwendet werden ({host}).
